2609.20821.title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
2609.20821.paper_summary: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.
2609.20821.paper_summary_zh: 嵌入空間定義了語義相似性和距離的概念。<lb/>我們研究這些嵌入是否反映質量、距離、時間和體積的物理測量，這些測量允許一種獨特的、客觀的語義等價和距離概念。<lb/>我們發現物理測量在嵌入空間中僅被弱地建模，而相反，可以觀察到相當特殊的測量模式。<lb/>進一步的分析表明，物理測量的嵌入表示受到表面字符串相似性的強烈影響，而相似性的重新校準並未實質性改善對齊。
2609.20821.author: Juri Opitz et.al.
